patterns.code_snippet:
local balance = 1000000000
local amount = 2147483647
local new_balance = balance + amount

metadata.description: Potential integer overflow detected with arithmetic operations exceeding INT_MAX
examples: if balance + amount > INT_MAX then error("Overflow") end

patterns.code_snippet:
local balance = 100
local amount = -2147483648
local new_balance = balance + amount

metadata.description: Potential integer underflow detected with arithmetic operations below INT_MIN
examples: if balance - amount < INT_MIN then error("Underflow") end

patterns.code_snippet:
function transfer(to, value)
    if balance >= value then
        call_external(to, value)
        balance = balance - value
    end
end

metadata.description: External call made before state changes, allowing reentrancy attacks
examples:
balance = balance - value
call_external(to, value)

patterns.code_snippet:
local private_key = "0x1234567890abcdef"
local secret_key = "my_secret"

metadata.description: Hardcoded private keys or sensitive data detected in code
examples: local private_key = os.getenv('PRIVATE_KEY')

metadata.description: Missing access control check in sensitive function
examples: if msg.sender ~= owner then error("Unauthorized") end

metadata.description: Function is missing a return statement which may cause undefined behavior
examples:
function processMessage()
    -- logic
    return true
end

patterns.code_snippet: perform_expensive_operation()

metadata.description: Code patterns that can cause service unavailability through expensive operations
examples: if gas_remaining < MIN_GAS then return end

patterns.code_snippet:
external_call(recipient, amount)
-- No return value check

metadata.description: External function calls without proper error handling or return value checks
examples:
local success = external_call(recipient, amount)
if not success then error("Call failed") end

metadata.description: Functions that can drain resources or destroy contracts without proper safeguards
